title: Proper Watering
description: Water your indoor plants when the top 1-2 inches of soil feel dry. Overwatering can cause root rot.

title: Sunlight & Placement
description: Keep your plants near bright, indirect sunlight. Avoid direct harsh rays to prevent leaf burn.

title: Fertilizing Routine
description: Feed your plants once every 4–6 weeks using organic fertilizer to promote healthy growth.

title: Soil & Potting Care
description: Use well-draining soil and repot annually to ensure proper aeration and nutrient balance.
